description: This file defines the routing setup for the backend Node.js application using Express. It sets up a base route to verify server reachability and a health-check endpoint delegated to a separate healthRouter module.

methods.name: router.get('/')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to the root endpoint, returning a JSON message indicating the server is reachable.

methods.name: router.use('/health', healthRouter)
methods.description: Delegates requests to '/health' to the healthRouter module.
